question:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff466c903e1e7db0b08113a275cd61cc8d2c7d935e422cd09e810bf27da4b8ca.png] 

Select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the above figure.
solution:
**The logic followed here is:** The sum of the numbers either row-wise or column-wise is 25.

1st row) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bcf00f8cf7ee1798f8a235a740ad8fb8f0eca79965abca94b223d8038e078667.png] ⇒ 15 + 6 + 4 = 25

And,

2nd row) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c024477701ab9283b70d9aa15b69e3256052863f875d5f04e6dbe31d7f70716.png] ⇒ 4 + 9 + 12 = 25

Similarly,

3rd row) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad8f53cc1edb8a4393c173962fd1033d58107994446b04c40e4101bbad2e5b95.png] ⇒ 6 + ? + 9 = 25 ⇒ 15 + ? = 25 ⇒ **? = 10** 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
